A map of the Nigeria area in the mid-19th century showing the vast extent of the Sokoto Caliphate. The Caliphate covers most of the northern region. Two stars mark the twin capitals: Sokoto (East) and Gwandu (West). Key emirate cities like Kano, Zaria, Katsina, Bauchi, Adamawa, Nupe (Bida), and Ilorin are shown as dots. To the northeast is the independent Borno Empire. To the southwest is the declining Oyo Empire. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
